tasks.label: Build image (no cache)
tasks.detail: Fresh build. Required before a Scout scan: the apk upgrade layer caches, so a cached build reports OS CVEs that are already fixed upstream.

tasks.label: Lint Dockerfile (hadolint)
args: docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint hadolint --ignore DL3008 - < docker/Dockerfile && echo 'hadolint: no findings'

tasks.label: Audit dependencies (pip-audit)
tasks.detail: pip was removed from the image in v1.1.7, so this audits requirements.txt from an isolated host venv, matching ci.yml.

tasks.label: Run unit tests (container)
tasks.detail: Canonical test path. Running these against the host Python fails on macOS: the fixtures assume Linux paths and no /var -> /private/var symlink.

tasks.label: Run integration suite
tasks.detail: ./tests/runtests.sh — builds its own test image and performs real downloads

tasks.label: Smoke test image
tasks.detail: WEB_ENABLED=false is required: entrypoint.sh defaults it to true, and in that mode it execs Gunicorn and discards the CLI arguments, so the task would hang forever.

tasks.label: Scan image (Docker Scout)
tasks.detail: Run after 'Build image (no cache)' or the results are unreliable

tasks.label: Quality gate (all checks)
tasks.detail: Everything /quality-check runs, in order, stopping at the first failure
args: set -e; python3 -m py_compile docker/fetcher.py docker/web/app.py docker/web/routes.py docker/web/jobs.py scripts/check_dependencies.py; echo '✓ syntax'; docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint hadolint --ignore DL3008 - < docker/Dockerfile; echo '✓ hadolint'; python3 -m venv .audit-venv && .audit-venv/bin/pip install --quiet --upgrade pip-audit && .audit-venv/bin/pip-audit -r docker/requirements.txt; docker build --no-cache --pull -f docker/Dockerfile -t ia-mirror:local docker; echo '✓ build'; docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh -v '${workspaceFolder}/tests:/app/tests:ro' -w /app ia-mirror:local -lc 'pytest tests/test_fetcher.py tests/test_web_backend.py tests/test_watcher_service.py tests/test_file_browser_api.py -q'; ./tests/runtests.sh; docker scout cves --only-severity critical,high local://ia-mirror:local
